knowledge_answers.rationale: An umpire must not give a batter out without an appeal from the fielding side.
A substitute may field and may keep wicket only with umpire consent; a substitute may not bowl or act as captain.

Retirement for an unavoidable cause carries a right to resume and otherwise records Retired-not out; a tactical or other reason requires opposing-captain consent to resume and otherwise records Retired-out.
A completed last innings eliminates the unfinished-match draw route; equal aggregate scores without a winner meet the Tie definition; a zero-run win is not the result label.

Contact with an object grounded beyond the boundary makes the fielder grounded beyond; the catch was not complete because movement control was not yet achieved; the ball is therefore grounded beyond the boundary and the striker is not Caught.
